# V8 binary license

Unmodified V8 LICENSE from the rusty_v8 150.4.0 V8 submodule revision
`c4ca1eccb90c5464d826b7713dc27178a53b0cfe`:
https://github.com/denoland/v8/blob/c4ca1eccb90c5464d826b7713dc27178a53b0cfe/LICENSE

SHA-256: `6ab33af8774a0f396ee3aeeb761e3229057682d6f9fa7f572e390c2cb3a6e509`

The Rust `v8` crate declares the MIT wrapper license. `about.hbs` also includes
V8's BSD license explicitly because cargo-about's crate graph cannot discover
the static C++ engine license from that MIT manifest. Keep this file and the
template section in sync when updating the V8 pin.
